name: Balance Board Stand
steps: Place a BOSU ball dome-side up on a flat floor near a wall if needed for light support.
Step carefully onto the center of the dome with one foot and lift your opposite foot off the floor.
Soften your standing knee slightly and make small, steady ankle adjustments to stay balanced for the target duration.
Step down under control and switch sides to repeat on the opposite foot.
tips: Fix your gaze on a stationary spot ahead of you to steady your balance.
Keep your hips level rather than letting your lifted hip drop toward the floor.
